end.summary:
Compared distances by converting kilometres and metres into metres.
Practised ordering distances and finding differences by subtraction.
Used conversions accurately in later examples, including mixed units.
Initially compared 900 m and 1 km by number appearance; this was corrected through later conversions.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised converting kilometres to metres, ordering distances, and subtracting to find how much farther one route is. Arjun used the conversion method in later questions, including finding 500 m and 1,430 m differences. At first, they compared 900 m and 1 km by the size of the written number, but corrected this by converting both to metres later. At home, ask them to compare two mixed-unit distances by converting both to metres first.
